sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Passing arrays to methods lets you work with whole collections of data at once - no more copying values one by one!

• How to send an entire array to a method
• Why arrays are passed differently than single variables
• Practical examples you can use right away

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Imagine you're moving houses. Instead of carrying each book one by one, you pack them all in a box and hand the whole box to your friend. That's exactly how passing arrays to methods works!

When you pass an array to a method, you're giving the method access to the entire 'box' of values at once. The method can then read or modify any element inside.

• Arrays are passed by reference (they point to the same memory location)
• This means changes inside the method affect the original array
• It's super efficient - no need to copy all the data

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: When an array is passed to a method, the reference is passed by value
The method can modify the array elements through the reference
Changes to array elements inside the method are visible to the caller
The method cannot change which array the caller's variable references
The for-each loop (for (type var : array)) simplifies reading all elements

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Arrays are passed to methods by reference - changes affect the original. Method parameters use array syntax: `type[] parameterName`. Practice by writing methods that modify arrays in place.

questions.question: When an array is passed to a method, what is actually passed?
options: A copy of the entire array
A reference to the array object
questions.explanation: When an array is passed to a method, the reference to the array is passed. This means the method can modify the original array's elements.

questions.question: If a method modifies an array element received as a parameter, is the original array affected?
options: Yes, because the reference to the original array is passed
Only if the array is declared as final
questions.explanation: Since the method receives a reference to the original array, any modifications to the array elements inside the method affect the original array.
